in_sample_ablation.note: Ablation reference, not an out-of-sample result. Rules whose YAML names promptfoo, llm-guard or NeMo Guardrails, or carries the vendor-corpus-import author tag, were written from these suites. without_rules_naming_source re-measures every lane without them; it is the figure to cite beside the headline. It approximates an out-of-sample figure without guaranteeing one: rules that do not name a vendor can still carry vendor text (breakdown.overlaps.rule_text), and some vendor samples also occur in garak-full, a corpus other rules were mined from (breakdown.overlaps.garak_full). without_rules_naming_or_sharing_text also removes every rule whose YAML shares a 40-character run with a vendor sample.

without_rules_naming_source.description: every rule whose YAML text matches /promptfoo|\bllm[-_ ]?guard\b|\bnemo\b|vendor-corpus-import/i (promptfoo, llm-guard, NeMo / NeMo Guardrails, the vendor-corpus-import author tag)

without_rules_naming_or_sharing_text.description: the rules removed by without_rules_naming_source, and every rule whose YAML shares a 40-character run with a vendor sample (breakdown.overlaps.rule_text)

overlaps.method: rule_text: every string in each rule's parsed YAML (test cases, patterns, descriptions) compared with every sample after folding whitespace and typographic quotes and lower-casing; a rule overlaps a sample when they share a run of 40 characters. garak_full: for each vendor attack sample, the prompt of data/test-corpora/garak-full/*.json holding the largest share of the sample's distinct 40-character folded runs; listed when that share is at least 0.5 (contained = the whole sample occurs in the prompt; shared-template = a jailbreak template shared with the payload slot filled differently).

precision_not_citable.reason: The vendors ship 20 benign test cases (llm-guard 16, NeMo Guardrails 4, promptfoo none). That is too few for a precision or false-positive-rate claim: metrics.precision and metrics.fp_rate are the bare ratios the schema requires, and data/stats.json projects them as null. Cite the counts instead.
